trigger_definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_set_planned1 BEFORE INSERT ON public.costing_response FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_planned1_date()
CREATE TRIGGER trg_set_planned1 BEFORE INSERT ON public.production FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_planned1_date()
CREATE TRIGGER trg_set_planned2 BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.costing_response FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_planned2_from_actual2()
CREATE TRIGGER trg_set_composition_no BEFORE INSERT ON public.costing_response FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_new_composition_no()
